name: Li Han-lin
bio: Li Han-lin is a Chinese poet named in Charles Budd’s Chinese Poems (1912). Budd attributes one T’ang-dynasty poem to him under this name, separately from Li T’ai-po, and gives no note for him.
The poems here are Charles Budd’s versions in Chinese Poems (1912), given under the poet’s name as Budd romanises it.

poems.title: Beauty's Fatal Snare
poems.author: Li Han-lin
